purpose: Read-only probe of Nembadminton public GraphQL ranking progression

profileRoute.note: The unauthenticated HTTP response is the SPA shell; the bundled route metadata marks player/:playerID/stats as requiresAuth=true.

frontendEvidence.query: query memberStats($id: ID!){ memberStats(id: $id){ member { id name } mix { version points } single { version points } double { version points } } }

sample.name: Adnan Bacic
sample.sourceOfId: public highestPointGain(clubhouseId: 331, category: HS, limit: 5, orderBy: DESC, vintages: [SEN,U17,U19,U15,U13,U11,U9])

enumeration.memberStats: Requires a known member ID; no date argument and no list argument.
enumeration.highestPointGain: Publicly enumerates members for a known clubhouse/category/vintage combination and exposes member IDs, so GSB's roster can be seeded without login.
enumeration.dates: memberStats returns the dates stored for that member; there is no separate public all-dates endpoint in the inspected schema.
enumeration.arbitraryPlayers: Not proven enumerable across all players/clubs without a known clubhouse or member ID.
